projectDescription: A lightweight C/C++ shared library for building X11 desktop GUI applications with UI elements, raster image canvases, drawing primitives, OpenGL integration, and event handling.
keyFeatures: Minimal C API usable from C and C++ programs
Built-in UI elements: text, buttons, inputs, checkboxes, consoles, rects, ellipses
Raster image canvas with per-pixel drawing primitives (rect, circle, line, triangle, sprite)
TGA (indexed, RLE-compressed) and XBM image loading and rendering
In-window OpenGL rendering via GLX offscreen pixmaps
Frame-accurate main loop with delta time and target FPS
Event system: keyboard, mouse, click, resize, scroll, move callbacks
Modal dialogs (alert, confirm, input) and queued background tasks
Window scrolling with optional scrollbar, tooltip support, cursor customization
